description: Two filename spellings of the same locale — extensionless 'en' and 'en.json' — in one directory. Both resolve to Locale en and the load fails with a duplicate-file diagnostic. CORRECTED BY REVIEW to loadOnly: true; the authored version said false while its own description said otherwise, which left the oracle building a Strings it must fail to build. It survives only because no lookup case names it, and would abort the whole corpus build the moment one did.
